blocks.prompt: 13 The vector \(\underline{u} = 50\underline{i} + 75\underline{j} + 65\underline{k}\) shows how many belts, pants, and shirts were sold at a store. The vector \(\underline{w} = 1500\underline{i} + 3500\underline{j} + 3000\underline{k}\) shows the price (in rupees) of each item. Find \(\underline{u} \cdot \underline{w}\) and explain what the result tells us in real life.
blocks.explanation:
Yeh dukaan ka hisaab hai jo dot product se hota hai.
Diya kya hai? Ek vector mein bechi gayi cheezon ki tadaad (belts, pants, shirts), doosre mein har cheez ki qeemat.
Find kya karna hai? \(\underline{u} \cdot \underline{w}\), aur yeh ke is number ka asal zindagi mein kya matlab hai.
Rule kaunsa? Dot product: milte julte components multiply kar ke jama.
Plan: har cheez ki kamai nikal kar teeno ko jama karna.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: tadaad \(\underline{u} = 50\underline{i} + 75\underline{j} + 65\underline{k}\) (belts, pants, shirts); qeematein \(\underline{w} = 1500\underline{i} + 3500\underline{j} + 3000\underline{k}\) rupees.
Humein find karna hai: \(\underline{u} \cdot \underline{w}\) aur us ka matlab.
Tareeqa: \(\underline{u} \cdot \underline{w} = u_1w_1 + u_2w_2 + u_3w_3\) (14.2.5). Kyun yahan dot product? Kyunke belts ki tadaad sirf belts ki qeemat se multiply honi chahiye, pants ki pants se; dot product bilkul yahi karta hai: pehla pehle se, doosra doosre se.

Milte julte components multiply karein
\[50 \times 1500 = 75{,}000\]
\[75 \times 3500 = 262{,}500\]
\[65 \times 3000 = 195{,}000\]
Kyun: Bechi gayi tadaad \(\times\) ek cheez ki qeemat \(=\) us cheez se aane wali raqam. Misaal: 50 belts, har ek 1500 rupay ka, to belts se 75,000 rupay.

Jama karein
\[\underline{u} \cdot \underline{w} = 75{,}000 + 262{,}500 + 195{,}000\]
\[= 532{,}500\]
Kyun: Dot product ka aakhri qadam teeno products ka jama hai, yani teeno cheezon ki kamai ek saath.

Matlab aur tasdeeq
\[262{,}500 + 195{,}000 = 457{,}500\]
\[457{,}500 + 75{,}000 = 532{,}500 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Doosri tarteeb se jama kiya, wohi total aaya. Yeh number dukaan ki kul aamdani (total revenue) hai jo saari belts, pants aur shirts bech kar mili. Dhyan rahe: yeh munafa (profit) nahi, kyunke cheezon ki laagat abhi minus nahi ki.
blocks.final_answer: \(\underline{u} \cdot \underline{w} = 532{,}500\): dukaan ko teeno cheezon ki bikri se kul Rs. 532,500 aamdani hui.
